No power-on test, no screen/UI shown, no rear port shot, no serial/model sticker visible.
No photo of the actual controllers out of the box, and no photo of the claimed UK receipt.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DERA NWOYE' overlays the image; no other identifying marks visible.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on, reaching the home screen, and loading one installed game
Screenshot of system settings showing firmware version and jailbreak/payload status
Photo of both controllers out of the box, one connected and functioning
Photo of the rear serial/model sticker and power adapter plug
Clear photo of the actual UK purchase receipt
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PS4 Slim bundle with two DualShock 4 controllers, so a worst-case price is possible, but every functional and provenance claim (hacked status, no overheating, ports working, UK origin, receipt, controller condition) is unverifiable from the single static photo and must be priced as unproven/non-working until supporting video or close-up proof is given.
